### Executive Summary

Active in-the-wild exploitation targeting older installations of Plex Media Server has been reported. Successful exploitation compromises target systems, allowing threat actors to commandeer infected devices and recruit them into a botnet ("zombie" machines).

Plex Media Server owners and administrators are urged to update their software installations immediately to protect against active compromise.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

The reported attacks specifically target legacy and older software versions of Plex Media Server. Successful exploitation leads to full host compromise, allowing attackers to take remote control of the underlying computer.

Specific root cause details, underlying vulnerability mechanisms, and vectors of initial access are not yet confirmed in the provided report. 

### Mitigation & IOCs

Administrators operating Plex Media Server are advised to perform the following immediate remediation action:
* Immediately update all older Plex Media Server installations to the latest available software version.
